codec_boundaries.video: H264/H265 complete Annex-B AU; no video transcode
codec_boundaries.aac: AAC ADTS canonical; FLV/RTSP/PS/TS remux; WHEP shared output AAC->Opus
codec_boundaries.g711: 8kHz mono PCMA/PCMU; no implicit AAC/Opus transcoding; HLS private-TS interoperability limit
codec_boundaries.whip: H264/H265 + optional Opus input; Opus->AAC boundary conversion; wire AAC/G711 not accepted
codec_boundaries.canonical_opus: RTSP passthrough decoded; RTMP/HTTP FLV code exists but FFmpeg 7.1.1 FLV rejects Opus before network publication, not certified.
codec_boundaries.whep_opus: 48kHz mono/stereo empty codec_config; passthrough needs compatible stereo, maxplaybackrate=48000, maxaveragebitrate=510000 and maxptime absent/120; default Chrome stereo source audio rejected, explicit compatible offer decodes.
codec_boundaries.audio_only: public publishers require video; internal audio-only component coverage is not end-to-end product support
